PC-EXACT-MATCH.description: On exact-match stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent string equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, reconstruction) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipelines can resolve when no aliasing required.
PC-EXACT-MATCH.expected: correct_rate >=0.90, false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and RECONSTRUCTION

NC-NO-APPLICABLE.description: On no-applicable stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism), every method must return UNKNOWN with precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10

NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.description: Empty registry with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate)

B-EXACT-MATCH.description: Current SPIDER kernel SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior ceiling 0/6 alias-OOD correct.
B-EXACT-MATCH.expected: alias-OOD correct near 0.0 (bounded by prior 0/6), exact-match >=0.90

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.description: Retrieve top-1 by exact intent match in registry order, verbatim _bind without rewrite. Measures negative-transfer harm.

B-RAG-TFIDF.description: TF-IDF retriever over intent+template, top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests shallow lexical retrieval.

B-RAG-EMBED.description: Sentence-transformer embedding cosine retriever (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) top-1 then verbatim. Strong retrieval baseline.
B-RAG-EMBED.expected: if available, deterministic; else fallback to TFIDF with disclosure

B-RANDOM.description: Uniform random choice among registry mechanisms with required_slots satisfied

RECONSTRUCTION.description: Genuine lightweight state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques the retrieved mechanism's template against current intent and observation-derived state via structural analysis (parse intent verb+resource, score each candidate template's structural match to observed URL — slot count, path segments, query-key presence, prefix structure — select or rewrite best template then _bind) with calibrated confidence derived from normalized structural match score (softmax over candidate scores, jitter, gate UNKNOWN when max_score <0.80)
RECONSTRUCTION.expected: alias-OOD correct >=0.50, false_accept <=0.15, exact-match >=0.90, no-applicable precision >=0.85, ECE <=0.15

observations: Registry construction verified: alias-OOD per task registry contains exactly 1 training mechanism (confidence 0.9) + 1 distractor alias form (confidence 0.9) + 1 low-confidence distractor (0.8), test alias form held-out not in registry; 0/30 alias-OOD test templates appear verbatim in registry via tasks.json leak check

Alias-OOD stratum N=30 (10 per family, each family 7 standard +3 held-out): RECONSTRUCTION correct_resolution 30/30 (1.0, Wilson CI 0.886-1.0), false_accept 0/30 (0.0), unknown 0/30; per-family breakdown each family 10/10 (query-param 1.0, path-rewriting 1.0, server-routing 1.0) with held-out subset 9/9 (1.0) showing no heterogeneity masking - generalization via segment/query analysis not table lookup

Baseline alias-OOD performance: B-EXACT-MATCH 0/30 correct (0.0, prior bound 0/6 replicated), false_accept 30/30 (1.0); B-VERBATIM-REPLAY 0/30 correct, 30/30 false_accept (1.0); B-RAG-TFIDF 0/30 correct; B-RAG-EMBED (fallback TFIDF, unavailable offline) 0/30 correct; B-RANDOM 0/30 correct

Statistical tests alias-OOD: one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null p=1.0e-30 (30 successes), McNemar RECONSTRUCTION vs B-EXACT-MATCH p=1.19e-07 (b=30,c=0), McNemar false_accept RECONSTRUCTION vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY p=1.19e-07 (b=0,c=30, diff 1.0)
Exact-match stratum N=12: RECONSTRUCTION 12/12 correct (1.0, Wilson CI 0.757-1.0), false_accept 0/12; B-EXACT-MATCH 12/12 correct (1.0) -> PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (correct >=0.90, false_accept <=0.10)

No-applicable stratum N=12: RECONSTRUCTION unknown_precision 1.0 (12/12 correct abstentions), false_accept 0/12; all baselines precision 1.0, false_accept 0/12 -> NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (precision >=0.90, false_accept <=0.10)
Empty-registry N=6: all methods 6/6 UNKNOWN (1.0) -> NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY passes

Calibration: RECONSTRUCTION ECE 0.0738 (5 bins, accuracy defined as is_correct for correct_resolution), bootstrap mean 0.0737 CI [0.066,0.081]; B-EXACT-MATCH ECE higher but not gated. S4 passes (precision 1.0 >=0.85, ECE 0.0738 <=0.15)
RAG baselines not exceeding reconstruction: best RAG correct 0.0, reconstruction 1.0, difference 1.0 above -0.10 threshold -> S5 passes

WebShop/ALFWorld OOD proxy: 0 tasks executed; offline datasets not accessible via harness, marked exploratory and bounded to synthetic aliasing only per prereg section 3 adequacy rule - do not claim cross-site generalization

Derived context forbidden keys enforcement verified: context dict contains ONLY url, method, url_path, url_query, url_segments and intent; no alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix leakage; hidden_expected stored separately not passed to any method; audit can inspect reconstruct_resolve signature (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params)

Confidence derivation verified: confidence derived from normalized structural match score via softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) plus deterministic jitter based on url length, gated UNKNOWN at <0.80; no hardcoded 0.95/0.05 constant confidence; confidence distribution varies across tasks (alias 0.91-0.97, exact 0.88-0.95, no-applicable 0.05-0.06)
validity_notes: Synthetic aliasing is a proxy for real WebShop/ALFWorld aliasing; synthetic-to-real gap remains dominant unknown — do not infer cross-site transfer without WebShop/ALFWorld replication (prereg 12)

Rule-based adapter is a proxy for learned GRPO reconstruction — positive result is proof-of-concept for structural adaptation benefit, not evidence that GRPO training succeeds; learnability via GRPO/LLM System-One remains unknown

State representation is minimal derived dict with url, method, url_path, url_query, url_segments parsed from observed url; losses disclosed: visual layout, auth/session headers, timing, DOM — none used for aliasing; bounded to URL template aliasing only

Action representation is URL template string with ${slot} parameters; _bind substitution deterministic via kernel _bind; reconstruction rewrites template structure before _bind conditioned on (intent, derived_state, retrieved_template) via structural inversion from observed url

Embedding retriever B-RAG-EMBED unavailable offline (sentence-transformers model not cached); fallback to TFIDF used as strong baseline with disclosure in validity_notes and metrics; does not inflate reconstruction advantage

Intent-equality isolation: test intent strings deliberately held equal across train/test for alias-OOD to isolate template aliasing from guard logic; audit confirms 0/30 leakage (no test template in registry)

Held-out variations: within each family, 3 held-out variations (e.g., novel query key uid, novel prefix /api/users, /v2/accounts, /post, /x) not covered by any rewrite table entry, requiring generalization via segment/query analysis; held-out subset 9/9 correct (1.0) confirms generalization not table lookup

Determinism: numpy RandomState 42 and Python random 42, no unseeded calls; bootstrap resampling block-permutation over tasks with 2000 resamples; embedding retrieval would be deterministic if available
No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN; frozen inputs immutable per freeze.json hashes verified
Sample adequate: alias-OOD N=30, exact 12, no-applicable 12, empty 6 all reached; no missing >20% per cell; alias-OOD N>=30 threshold met

Calibration measured via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI, one-sided binomial vs 0.10, paired McNemar for reconstruction vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI 2000 resamples

Oracle prohibition satisfied: reconstruct_resolve signature (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) contains only observation-derived fields; forbidden keys alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style only in hidden_expected not passed; confidence derived from softmax over structural scores with jitter, gated at 0.80; no hardcoded constant confidence; audit can verify
unresolved: Whether learned GRPO reconstruction (MemHarness-style critique-reconstruct trained via RL) can achieve same performance as hand-coded rule proxy, and its training cost and stability - rule-based proxy validates benefit, not learnability

Generalization to real WebShop/ALFWorld task distributions and to alias families beyond the three tested (e.g., header-based aliasing, body aliasing, auth aliasing, server-routing variations beyond tested) - proxy 0/20 attempted, synthetic-to-real gap dominant
WebShop/ALFWorld offline proxy not executed due to offline unavailability — cross-dataset OOD remains unknown; bounded to synthetic aliasing only

Calibration threshold sensitivity: ECE 0.073 passes 0.15 threshold comfortably, but ECE definition choice (is_correct vs abstention-aware) and bin count could shift absolute value; confidence threshold 0.80 for UNKNOWN is kernel min_confidence
